notes.title: Update 1.3 - Test Dummy Takedown
notes.notes:
Hello, crash testers!

Version 1.3 is finally here with tons of improvements and new features to make your battles even more epic!

Bug Fixes
Various bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience.

Improved multiplayer stability.

Interface Overhaul
All menus have been completely redesigned for a more modern and intuitive look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/c5dd34af872604389be8c2223801f60ab07390fd.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/63a79a0eaab416a3a7da8254c04a430d106f4358.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/0e757d90faf814d12d4a235b227c5ecf8ef7a279.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/1faa500f316b82608f3318d4bc0e1401ca8856ab.png

Easier navigation to quickly access all options.

New Multiplayer Features
Steam Friend Invites: Easily invite your friends directly through Steam.

Friends Only Servers: Create private matches and battle only with your friends.




Thank you for your support and feedback! Keep sharing your thoughts so we can make Test Dummy Takedown even more fun and intense!

See you on the battlefield!
The Test Dummy Takedown Team
